newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Sierra Leone talks agree nationwide truce.
newsitem.headline: Sierra Leone talks agree nationwide truce.

text.p: West African foreign ministers and envoys of Sierra Leone's military rulers agreed on Friday that there should be a truce throughout the West African nation.

A statement, read by Nigerian Foreign Minister Tom Ikimi after a second day of talks in Ivory Coast, said that the two sides agreed "to resolve all issues related to the Sierra Leone crisis peacefully".
The statement said that a ceasefire should be established "immediately throughout Sierra Leone".
It said the two sides had agreed to adjourn their meeting and meet again next Friday.

West African foreign ministers met the envoys from Sierra Leone's junta in Ivory Coast's commercial capital Abidjan as part of efforts to reverse a May 25 coup there and restore President Ahmad Tejan Kabbah to power.
The statement said that the two sides would "work towards early restoration of constitutional order". It did not elaborate.
